name: UFFD Plugin
description: This plugin syncs groups from UFFD to mattermost

settings.help_text: A (fully-anchored) regex that must match in order for a group to sync. If left empty, all groups will be synced. Any groups not matching this regex that were previously synced by this plugin will be removed on the next sync.
Instead of syncing groups as plugin-owned groups, sync them as 'custom groups' owned by system-bot. This is compatible with the Professional license tier.

settings.display_name: Name of group that gates access to Mattermost in uffd
settings.help_text: The name of the group which gates access to Mattermost in uffd. If set, then users who are no longer in this group will have their Mattermost account disabled. If left empty, then users will only have their Mattermost account disabled if their uffd account is disabled. This group doesn't need to be matched by the sync regex.

settings.display_name: Name of uffd group that will grant System Admin permissions
settings.help_text: A group which will grant the System Admin role. If non-empty, then users in this group will be added to the System Admin role, and removed if they are not present in the group. This only affects users synced from the IdP: locally-created users will not be touched.

settings.display_name: Name of uffd group that will grant System Manager permissions
settings.help_text: A group which will grant the System Manager role. If non-empty, then users in this group will be added to the System Manager role, and removed if they are not present in the group. This only affects users synced from the IdP: locally-created users will not be touched.
A Golang-style duration string (e.g. 15m for 15 minutes) for the time between sync attempts.
The endpoint of the Uffd instance to sync to.
The username of the Uffd API user to use for syncing. Must have the user permission.
The password of the Uffd API user to use for syncing.
